solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Culinary mixture from mother sadly turned

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother

indicators.note: turned tells us to read the word for sadly from back to front

parts.note: alas is an exclamation meaning sadly or unfortunately

explanation.surface: Something mother cooked up went off and has turned bad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sadly' looks like an adverb on the surface, but it stands for the exclamation of regret.
explanation.definitionFit: Masala is a blend of ground spices used in South Asian cooking, a culinary mixture.

clue.text: Process set a mobile off

indicators.note: off suggests something gone wrong, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Setting a mobile phone to off.
explanation.definitionFit: To metabolise food is to process it chemically in the body.

clue.text: Step from street on carriage

parts.note: air means carriage or bearing, how one holds oneself

explanation.surface: Stepping down from a carriage onto the street.
explanation.definitionFit: A stair is a single step in a flight.

clue.text: Liberal is certain to be flexible

parts.note: some means certain, as in some people

explanation.surface: A Liberal is sure to be willing to bend.
explanation.definitionFit: Lissome means supple and lithe, so bending easily, flexible.

clue.text: Bird rocking bar second time

indicators.note: bar means except, and second says it is the second of two matching letters that goes

parts.note: startling, like rocking, means shocking or astonishing

explanation.surface: A bird bobbing about on a bar for the second time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rocking' looks like movement but means STARTLING; 'bar' (except) removes its second T, the time abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: A starling is a common speckled songbird known for its huge swirling flocks.

clue.text: Headwear is answer: the very thing that's elevated artist

indicators.note: elevated in a down clue means lifted upwards, so the pieces read from bottom to top

parts.note: it means the very thing, as in that's it
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: Royal headwear is just the thing for a celebrated artist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's elevated' turns AIT to give TIA before RA.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiara is a jewelled ornamental headband, a kind of headwear.

clue.text: Recalled cleric sanctioned

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, is a cleric
OK'd means approved or sanctioned

explanation.surface: A clergyman was recalled after the move was sanctioned.
explanation.definitionFit: To revoke an order is to cancel or withdraw it, so recalled.

clue.text: Anxious pupil late as everyone gathers

indicators.note: gathers means the phrase holds the answer within its run of letters

explanation.surface: A tardy schoolchild is nervous as the whole class assembles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gathers' points to the letters running across pupil, late, as and everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill at ease is an idiom for uncomfortable or uneasy, which is anxious.

clue.text: Fat boy hugs hard

indicators.note: hugs means the exclamation wraps around the letter

parts.note: boy! and gee! are both exclamations of surprise
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: An overweight lad gives someone a firm hug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boy' is the exclamation, not a lad; 'hugs' puts H inside GEE.
explanation.definitionFit: Ghee is clarified butter used in Indian cookery, a cooking fat.

clue.text: Genuine fun, ultra running

indicators.note: running suggests the letters are on the move into a new order

explanation.surface: Ultramarathons are real fun.
explanation.definitionFit: Unartful means artless or sincere, with no guile, so genuine.

clue.text: Queen's new painting backing screen around shrine

indicators.note: backing tells us to read the whole run of pieces from end to start

parts.note: Queen Anne, with the possessive giving the S
art is a general word for painting

explanation.surface: A royal's new painting is set behind a screen around a shrine.
explanation.walkthrough: One indicator, 'backing', turns the whole of ANNESNART to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A transenna is a latticework barrier enclosing a shrine in an early Christian church.

clue.text: See you accepting conclusion of TV regulator

indicators.note: accepting means the farewell word takes another letter inside it

parts.note: vale is Latin for farewell, a parting like see you

indicators.note: the conclusion of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Saying goodbye while taking in the end of a TV show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accepting' puts V, the last letter of TV, inside VALE.
explanation.definitionFit: A valve is a device controlling the flow of a fluid, hence a regulator.

clue.text: Stakes protecting shelter sailor waterproofs

indicators.note: protecting means the word for stakes wraps round the other pieces

parts.note: stakes are bets placed on an outcome
an arbour is a shady garden shelter
Jack, as in Jack Tar, is a nickname for a sailor

explanation.surface: Gambling stakes surround a sailor in his shelter, wearing waterproofs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'protecting' puts ARBOURJACK inside BETS. Barbour is a British brand of waxed cotton outdoor jackets.
explanation.definitionFit: Barbour jackets are waxed outdoor coats, waterproofs made by a well-known British firm.

clue.text: Organised rebel caught earl of little brain

indicators.note: organised means the letters are put into a new arrangement

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: An organised revolt caught a nobleman lacking intelligence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of little brain' looks like an insult but refers to the cerebellum, Latin for little brain.
explanation.definitionFit: Cerebellar means relating to the cerebellum, whose name means little brain.

clue.text: Pull out knife unsheathed

indicators.note: unsheathed suggests a blade drawn from its cover, so the outer letters are stripped away

parts.note: a cleaver is a heavy butcher's knife

explanation.surface: Drawing a knife out of its sheath.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unsheathed' strips the outer letters C and R from CLEAVER.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave something, as in quitting a contest, is to pull out of it.

clue.text: Pondering blocking half-hearted friend in droll manner

indicators.note: blocking means the word for pondering sits inside the other
half-hearted means one of the two middle letters is lost

parts.note: an ally is a friend
musing means pondering

explanation.surface: Thinking gets in the way of a lukewarm friendship, in a funny way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half-hearted' removes one of the two middle letters, leaving ALY around which the pondering sits.
explanation.definitionFit: Amusingly means in a funny or entertaining way, so in a droll manner.

clue.text: Dragon shot by strafe

parts.note: fired means shot, as of a gun
to rake is to sweep with gunfire, to strafe

explanation.surface: A dragon brought down by an aircraft's strafing fire.
explanation.definitionFit: Firedrake is an old word for a fire-breathing dragon of legend.

clue.text: Communicating with soldiers preparing to besiege island

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, soldiers

indicators.note: to besiege means to surround, so the word for preparing encloses the island

parts.note: doing can mean preparing, as in doing the vegetables

explanation.surface: Troops send signals while getting ready to lay siege to an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is only a link; RA, the Royal Artillery, is a common crossword stand-in for soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Radioing means sending messages by radio, a way of communicating.

clue.text: Fledgling left in nest fell out

parts.note: a squab is a young pigeon not yet fledged

indicators.note: in tells us the letter for left goes inside the word for nest

parts.note: a bed can be a nest or resting place

explanation.surface: A young bird left alone in the nest fell out of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fell out' looks like a tumble from the nest but means quarrelled.
explanation.definitionFit: To squabble is to quarrel, so squabbled means had a row or fell out.

clue.text: One demolishes empty biofuel plant

indicators.note: empty means the word loses its inside, leaving its first and last letters

parts.note: an aster is a daisy-like flowering plant

explanation.surface: A demolition worker clears out a biofuel plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plant' reads as a factory but is the flower ASTER.
explanation.definitionFit: A blaster is one who uses explosives, someone who demolishes.

clue.text: Professor's calm man

indicators.note: what one professes is what one declares out loud, so this signals a sound-alike

parts.note: peace is a state of calm

explanation.surface: An academic is a calm sort of man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Professor's' reads as what is declared aloud, so PEACE is heard and PIECE written.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess, each playing piece can be called a man.

clue.text: Grant dividing item of charcuterie board

indicators.note: dividing means the word for grant splits the other word

parts.note: pate is a meat paste sold in delicatessens
to let means to allow or grant

explanation.surface: Something given separates items on a charcuterie board.
explanation.walkthrough: 'board' looks part of the meat platter but is the definition, the artist's board.
explanation.definitionFit: A palette is the thin board on which a painter mixes colours.

clue.text: Deny and dismiss current projection introduced by inspector

indicators.note: introduced by means the inspector's abbreviation comes before the other pieces

parts.note: DI is Detective Inspector, a police rank
to sack is to dismiss from a job
now means current, at the present time
a ledge is a shelf projecting from a wall

explanation.surface: An inspector introduces a plan to deny everything and fire people.
explanation.definitionFit: To disacknowledge is to refuse to admit or own something, a dated synonym of deny.

clue.text: King with Germanic name and Mongol titles

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
Hans is a common German man's name

explanation.surface: A king with a German name holds Mongol titles.
explanation.definitionFit: Khan is a title for a ruler among the Mongols, so khans are such titles.

clue.text: Wheat you stored in cylindrical container

indicators.note: stored in means the letter for you is placed inside the container

parts.note: a drum is a cylindrical container, as for oil
U is text-speak for you

explanation.surface: Grain of yours is kept in a drum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stored in' puts U inside DRUM.
explanation.definitionFit: Durum is a hard wheat used for pasta, a variety of wheat.

clue.text: Bring up rear of weak group in competition

indicators.note: bring up the rear of a word means its last letter is lifted higher, as fits a down answer

parts.note: tame can mean weak or feeble, lacking spirit

explanation.surface: Stragglers bring up the rear of a weak side in a contest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bring up rear of' lifts the last E of TAME to second place.
explanation.definitionFit: A team is a side of players who play together in a contest.

clue.text: Figure scoffed audibly

indicators.note: audibly says the word for scoffed is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: to scoff is to eat greedily, so scoffed means ate

explanation.surface: Someone noisily scoffed at a number.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scoffed' looks like mockery but means ate, which said aloud matches the number.
explanation.definitionFit: Eight is a number, and a number can be called a figure.

clue.text: Stark article penned by relative regularly (quarterly)

indicators.note: penned by means the article is enclosed by the relative

parts.note: an aunt is a relative
A is the indefinite article

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A bare article written by a relative for a quarterly magazine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stark' is an adjective here, as in stark naked; '(quarterly)' is the word the alternate letters come from.
explanation.definitionFit: Au naturel means naked, so stark as in stark naked.

clue.text: Local dignitary dressing on ship

parts.note: mayo is short for mayonnaise, a salad dressing
re means on or concerning
SS stands for steamship

explanation.surface: Salad dressing served on board a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A mayoress is a female mayor or the mayor's consort, a civic dignitary.

clue.text: Drill behind me charges

indicators.note: charges here means loads or fills, so the word for behind is filled with another

parts.note: rear means behind
taken as written

explanation.surface: A drill charges at me from behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charges' reads as a bill or an attack but means fills, the rear being loaded.
explanation.definitionFit: A reamer is a tool for widening or finishing holes, a kind of drill.
